description:
Screen the market for tokens that smart-money wallets are currently accumulating or distributing. Returns a ranked list of tokens with high smart-money activity across the specified chains. Use it when the user asks what smart money is currently buying, which tokens are being accumulated, or wants to discover high-conviction smart-money plays.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

chains.description: Optional list of chains to include.

name: screen_smart_money
